_note: THE INDUSTRIAL FAMILY, 1 OF 10: THE RUNAWAY PLANT.
The plant was left running when its crew ran, and it is about to cook itself. Shut it down from the control terminal
and keep the occupiers off it while it winds down. The verb is STOP.
Industrial dungeons (LocTypeDungeon_ThemeIndustrial, 20 per Eliza's count), vanilla interiors that carry the
delve markers today. Every word holds in any of them: nothing names the site, the faction or what the plant
made; everything a line points at is placed. Pay: med, capped.

place._theme: Industrial dungeons; the delve marker set.

prose.name: Shutdown: Runaway Plant on <Planet>
prose.briefing: The <Place> has been running unattended since its crew fled, and its owners say it won't last much longer.
prose.card: Shutdown contract. The <Place> on <Planet> is running unattended and over its limits. Reach the control terminal and complete a safe shutdown. The site is occupied. Payment on contract completion.

beats.journal: The shutdown is running. It takes as long as it takes, and the people living in the <Place> have heard it start.
beats.name: Plant Control Terminal
say: It's winding down? Good. Don't let anyone near that terminal till it's finished, or it starts all over again.

beats.objective: Keep the terminal running until the shutdown completes
beats.journal: The <Place> is shut down safely, and stays that way. Nobody got to the terminal before it finished.
say: That's it. It's cold. First quiet that place has had in a month.

broadcast: You're at the site? The control terminal is inside. Start the shutdown and stay with it. It's slow, and it's noisy, and they'll come to see what's changed.
_speech: On a board the broadcast waits for him at the site. Not yet heard in game; his ear decides. No names, places, factions or currency in a voiced line.
